card.name: Is/are before availability or offering
card.fires_on: Forms of 'be' (are, is, will be) or a plural noun right after a subject, where the next words say what is offered, available, listed or shown. Seen in web text about products, courses, shows and services.

modes.label: Be-verb before availability
modes.description: The verb 'are', 'is' or 'will be' follows a thing that is about to be said to be available, on offer or presented.
modes.example: You might wonder why you need a prescription if many PPIs<< are>> available over the counter.
